emma (Product): Quick sync — planning a 'slice priming' step before canaries to warm caches and KV layers.
raj (Eng-Platform): +1. Need to define priming window, sample size, and signal checks. My thought: 5–10% traffic for 3 mins.
tess (Eng Runtime): 5–10% sounds fine. Priming should send real traffic through full path (auth, routing, cache). Also mark priming traffic so it doesn't count toward user metrics.
mike (SRE): Agree. Must have automated abort if error rate > 1.5% or p95 latency regresses > 30% vs baseline.
olivia (Data): Can we run a dry-run shadow of priming first to compute expected telemetry? I can prepare queries to compare error/latency deltas.
emma (Product): Good call. Proposed flow: shadow priming (no effect) -> live priming (flag on) -> canary -> rollforward. Each step has clear gate thresholds.
raj (Eng-Platform): For flags: we'll add 3 states: off, priming, canary. Flag payload example:
```
flag: inference_rollout
states: {off, priming, canary}
priming_pct: 10
canary_pct: 1
```
raj (Eng-Platform): In priming state, traffic routes to new variant but responses still routed to old model for verification, unless QA gives explicit green.
tess (Eng Runtime): Also need a hot-swap hook: if priming errors spike or GPU OOMs, route back instantly to previous model and escalate.
mike (SRE): Hot-swap criteria: any sev2 within 2 mins OR sustained p99 latency > 3x baseline for 1 min -> auto rollback + page SRE.
olivia (Data): I'll provide the stat tests (FTR) for priming vs baseline and a small script to compute significance. ETA EOD today.
emma (Product): Launch criteria checklist (short): 1) Priming shadow metrics look normal 2) Live priming within gates for 10 min 3) Canary passes 30 min ramp targets 4) No customer opt-outs failing 5) Playbook updated.
raj (Eng-Platform): Notes: we should run a simulation in staging that injects priming_pct ramp and induced latency to validate rollback paths. I'll schedule a run tomorrow.
emma (Product): @mike can you add the SLO-based alert thresholds to the rollforward playbook? Also we need a quick kill switch on the flag (global) and tenant-specific emergency opt-out.
mike (SRE): Yep — will add global kill + per-tenant opt-out and implement a 'soft-shutdown' that drains inflight.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: rollout/priming/1747254321 -> state=queued by raj at 1747254500 :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
raj (Eng-Platform): I'll kick off the staging sim and post results. If sim looks good, we flip shadow -> live priming tomorrow morning 09:00 PT.
emma (Product): Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate checklist and assign owners. If nothing blocks, target soft-launch by Friday.
